name: Muro Horizontal — HP 2/3 Dañado
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo muro centrado en canvas transparente. Strictly top-down 90°. Tight bbox crop → resize 128×32.

frames.prompt: A single top-down cartoon sci-fi wall barrier sprite, centered on a fully transparent background. Camera is STRAIGHT DOWN at 90 degrees — only the TOP FACE is visible, NO side face, NO front face, NO 3D perspective. The wall is a wide flat horizontal rectangle (approx 4:1 width-to-height ratio). LIGHTLY DAMAGED state — one impact. Same dark armored steel surface as the intact version but with ONE bold cartoon crack — a thick jagged diagonal crack line slashing across ~50% of the top surface, with rough cartoon edges and a slightly lighter exposed interior. A small chip missing from one corner. The energy stripe along the bottom long edge is now BRIGHT ORANGE-YELLOW (#FFAA00) with orange bloom — the glow is less stable, slightly flickering. Two LED dots glow orange. Bold dark charcoal outline. Soft drop shadow. Transparent background, nothing else.
frames.negative_prompt: side view, front face, isometric, any 3D perspective, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, stone, sandy, beige, undamaged pristine, heavily destroyed, multiple cracks, text, watermark, background scenery
